design.sourceKind: Original authored geometry; no generated or third-party reference asset
design.brief: Indigo diamond monocoque with formed inset shoulder panels, cooling cassettes, canted aft vanes and one rectangular central ion outlet.
design.direction: Clean coated production racer, graphite structure, machined retaining lips, tinted glazing and restrained ion lighting. Distinct large forms within the established rival hull envelope.

model.authorship: Original Blender geometry authored with project-owned construction helpers; no third-party meshes, fonts or textures.
model.materials: Original clean procedural coated paint, resin composite and machined metal baked to embedded base-color, roughness, tangent-normal and short-range cavity-occlusion maps.
